donor: The Open Group Sensor Open Systems Architecture, not W3C SOSA/SSN

reference.title: Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture, Edition 1.1
reference.reviewed_selected_pages: PDF 49–54, 58, 64–74, 75–79, 83–93, 101–105, 115–119, 125–139, 141–149, 164–168, 171–182, 191–207, 384–389; representative relevant pages in each targeted chapter, not all pages nor all requirements

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Controls housekeeping: discovery, configuration, hardware/software readiness, state/mode, health and security of whole sensor/components; explicitly excludes mission tasking
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Descriptive architecture; no actual installed system, conformance, or mission-command success

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Coordinates mission requests and resources: task scheduling, processing request and mission operation
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Architecture-level Task Manager is not equivalent to fully finalized normative task API in 1.1

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Tasks and assignments a sensor or module can perform given its current health and configuration
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Not all theoretically designed capabilities are currently ready, physically available or executed

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Finite discrete condition of expected sensor/module/hardware behavior
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Distinct from lifecycle State, health Status or a default operating mode

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Top-level lifecycle condition of sensor, plug-in card or module, determined and represented from system-management viewpoint
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: State is not a modality mission assignment or independently observed hardware truth

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Condition related to performance/health; relevant changes can be reported as management notifications
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Health/performance Status does not equal operational lifecycle state, mode, or measured effect

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Current and projected component/sensor condition, diagnostic/BIT results, fault and health logs have separate management roles
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: No reported health measurement is established for any of four source cases by a C239 generic service description

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Health monitors condition, Operations handles current state/mode, Configuration handles discovery and user settings; Security management has analogous groups
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Functional management grouping is not a hardwired inventory, model superclass or vendor-specific command list

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: A different component may expose management interfaces for a managed component; manager/agent path supports direct/indirect supervision
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Management agent or proxy is not necessarily the physical managed unit, original measurement performer or ISA CIC

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: In-band depends on the operational message network; out-of-band supports management independently of that network in hardware-specific contexts
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Existence of a management path does not prove all power states are reportable or physically reachable

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Conditional original rules apply IP/REST/OpenAPI and syslog-based notifications to applicable in-band General Profile management interfaces
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Conditionally applicable implementation rules, not a CSAPI Profile obligation or evidence of live deployed transport

source_records.source_term: Syslog Fault, Status, State, Mode and Configuration notifications
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Distinct categories of management change notifications; source rules specify encoding and event-trigger behavior in applicable interfaces
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Syslog message is notification of reported state, not a performed Observation or proof original publisher authenticity

source_records.source_term: System Manager agent/manager and client/server relationship
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Manager initiates requests/acquires responses, agent represents sensor/component; manager may manage multiple agents
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Receiver/controller role is not automatically identity of a physical sensing element or independent device host

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Off, Starting, Operational, Cleansing, Stopping, Faulted; state diagram from System Manager viewpoint
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Off S0 often unreported; Operational means manager-assessed configured/healthy, not guaranteed current real installed telemetry

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: PIC states broadly parallel sensor lifecycle plus P6 Lost Communication
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Loss of manager/agent communication is not by itself a physical failure; PIC status not whole sensor status

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Module-specific state model including M6 Lost Communication and manager-reported lifecycle
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Software module state is distinct from PIC power state or overall sensor state; original p135 M5 prose includes a PIC wording anomaly

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: State diagrams are defined and aligned with enumerations, but specific transition policy/normative language deferred to future edition
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Do not turn expected transitions and explanatory prose into new mandatory transition SHALLs

source_records.original_locator: §7.1.1 and Table7.1.1-1 printed115–119/PDF141–145; App. A 'Task' and 'Assignment', printed358,363/PDF384,389
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: External task is mission request, internal assignment directs a module; preliminary operations include create/modify/delete, task/assignment status and health notifications
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Most table entries TBD or preliminary; request/acknowledgement does not prove completed mission, hardware action or source-true CommandStatus

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Module approach described but task management concept still being developed; source explicitly says not ready for publication in this edition
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Do not invent complete Task Manager normative API, conformance rules or universal task state encoding

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Signal conditioning, receive/excitation and energy–signal conversion are mission functions with task-specific input/output roles
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Functional modules are not a count of physical apertures or required physical transducers

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Detector/extractor and characterizer have reference-level functional descriptions, including output products
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: §9.1 expressly says module not defined for Edition1.1; do not promote functions to mandatory runtime capabilities

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Described function to ingest output of other SOSA and non-SOSA sources, adapt format, distribute to modules
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: §10.1 not defined for this edition; neither source-owner authenticity nor actual external sensor connectivity established

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Persistent storage/retrieval of logs, notifications, metadata or data streams; selected NVMe/PXE rules are specified
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Storage is not original Observation, source-to-copy lineage, universal history ledger or proof persisted real measurements

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Formatting, packaging and distributing sensor-derived data/products or sensor logs; table provides reference functions
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: §11.1 explicitly not defined for Edition1.1; no mandatory CSAPI DataStream or performed result semantics

source_records.source_term: Security Services and software integrity verification
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Security module can verify accepted software-package digest; original conditional rules specify authentication/storage on request
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Digest verification of a package is not cryptographic original observational data provenance, all software trust or publisher proof

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Sensor/PIC/module security posture may be Evaluating, Protected, Degraded, Compromised based on security policy
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Security posture is separate from sensor operational state, fault/status and actual mission capability

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Reference role for injection/test signals to support system calibration activity
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: §12.6 not defined in Edition1.1; source does not establish a metrologically traceable performed calibration for a case

source_records.source_term: Nav Data Service and Time/Frequency Service
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Described navigation and time/frequency reference support with quality/source metadata, distribution, translation and notification
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Platform nav/time information is not surveyed probe location, actual observation timestamp, measurement procedure or verified present source

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Bridge between sensor/host interactions and power/communications; can adapt external host format to SOSA internal interactions
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: A host interface does not identify actual attached probe, physical site point or external REST/CSAPI server

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Reference functional power conversion, conditioning, storage, distribution, protection and possible control/status
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: §12.11 states module NOT defined this edition; do not infer native installed battery, supply hardware/cardinality or mandatory management API

source_records.source_term: Power supply vs power-state and host power
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Host power flows into Host Platform Interface, potentially to functional Power module, with distinct physical supply versus status/control paths
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Power input, reserve, status reporting and successful action are separate claims; no actual example case electrical telemetry proven

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Described network monitoring, connectivity, QoS, intrusion and configuration support
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Service description does not prove interface availability or concrete transfer in any of the four source cases

source_records.original_locator: App. A entries printed359/PDF385; §4.2 Table4.2-1 printed26/PDF52
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: SOSA distinguishes minimally processed digital sensor data from processed/reduced information products
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Processing products are not automatically one performed source Observation or independent raw data claim

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: System Manager is a defined management module with subfunctions that can qualify generic role/service concepts
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: SOSA managing module is not ISA Controller service role or one-to-one physical component

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: SOSA external mission task request and internal assignment resemble issued action request patterns
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Task Manager interactions are preliminary; no proven user request or physical effect and no exact CSAPI Command mapping

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: SOSA task/assignment status and health reporting potentially qualify reported outcome concepts
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Published status and return codes not independent completed command or mission success

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Native SOSA Capability depends upon as-configured health and tasks/assignments, unlike ISA CCD static declarations
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: No assertion of equal actual mode/capability list or vendor hardware execution

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Finite SOSA Mode concept speaks to known behavior in a discrete mode
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Do not equate mode to default or current source-reported mode without evidence

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: SOSA mode and status message categories can contribute source-specific mode reporting notions
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Does not establish actual contemporaneous source-reported mode in one of four cases

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Sensor lifecycle/state is explicit separately from condition and health
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Do not equate SOSA state enum to ISA operating condition property

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Health diagnostics include BIT execution/results and fault reporting
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: No exact native ISA BIT property or actual device diagnostic measurement

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: SOSA reports status/health events but ISO-coded property Status report is a distinct message form
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Syslog notification is not an ISA Status property-value message

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: SOSA manager/agent may represent/manage a different component, similar to mediated participation
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: No exact ISA CIC performer/broker/relay semantics, source exposure or virtual UCI mapping

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: In-band management interface roles are networked conditional roles
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: SOSA client/server/agent role is not a unique ISA registered network participant

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Distinct notifications about state/status/fault/mode/configuration supply management change evidence
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Not equal to ISA Administrative event codes, original Observation or all messages actually delivered

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Manager-represented lifecycle at whole sensor and module/PIC level qualifies possible state context
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: State is not source-reported operating mode or proof observed live condition

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: PIC/module Lost Communication provides bounded example of diagnostic/availability ambiguity
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Loss of management path must not be treated as physical sensor health or measured actual failure

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Task assignment statuses offer some reported processing/execution context
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Not exact ISA current command execution record or verified hardware effect

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: SOSA functional modules can process sensory data but are not necessarily the physical observer
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Functional chain, data ingestor and physical sensing actor must remain separate

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Data product formatting and storage distinguish output stream/report fields and their provenance
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: No exact CSAPI resultSchema, actual Observation or original-to-digital-copy chain

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Security operational state/integrity and alerts may relate to tamper/health concepts
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Software integrity result/security state does not prove physical tamper condition

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Calibration module describes reference test signal injection separate from recurring observation procedures
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: No actual metrological calibration performed or reusable ObservingProcedure identity

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Host platform interface/nav/time supply site/host-related operational context
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Time/nav source is not surveyed position of individual instrument or installation history

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Source describes host power flow and functional power conversion/protection distinctions relevant to original case power hold
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Module reference only: no installed battery, exact voltage, state, control or actual power telemetry

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Possible power status/reference module supports concept of component power condition
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: Does not establish actual ISA Power State property equivalence or real source-state measurement

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Network monitoring and QoS roles are pertinent to connection/reporting-path distinctions
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: No real source-specific radio transmission, timing, CSAPI transfer or network health proof

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Managed capabilities and manager-reported state need separate readiness interpretation
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: A supported functionality is neither a source-attested current ready flag nor a reported actual state

source_qualified_correspondence.correspondence_reason: Preliminary task model contrasts request/state/status/health and actual implementation
source_qualified_correspondence.negative_equivalence_guard: No source case has authenticated issued, acknowledged, completed, physically verified command sequence

held_source_design_questions.source_bound: Task management explicitly preliminary; multiple table values TBD and mission-specific schemas unfinished
held_source_design_questions.required_non_inference: SOSA-C DSDM/source comparison may clarify native enumeration availability; do not invent full standard task API

held_source_design_questions.source_bound: Reference-only Power module, explicitly not defined in Edition 1.1
held_source_design_questions.required_non_inference: Keep power capability and hardware/power state as candidate evidence not normative 1.1 power service conformance

held_source_design_questions.source_bound: Several listed modules have descriptive reference functions but are not defined in this edition
held_source_design_questions.required_non_inference: Do not promote Table4.2-1 descriptions into normative conformance or universal DIM classes

held_source_design_questions.source_bound: S0 often unreportable; P6/M6 lost communication distinct from physical faults
held_source_design_questions.required_non_inference: No universal current-state assertion or exact ISA lifecycle mapping

held_source_design_questions.topic: Normative rule scope versus explanatory documentation
held_source_design_questions.source_bound: Specific rules exist for applicable General Profile protocols and notifications, while state-transition policies are not normative in 1.1

held_source_design_questions.topic: Source data model and API file access
held_source_design_questions.source_bound: Actual native C239-referenced DSDM/IDL and six OpenAPI companion files not inspected
held_source_design_questions.required_non_inference: SOSA-C must obtain and inspect or explicitly hold; no reverse-engineered full entity list

held_source_design_questions.source_bound: Source C239 reference architecture does not authenticate installed configurations or telemetry of Dragino/AirGradient/Campbell/Bennett
held_source_design_questions.required_non_inference: Preserve case source standing and avoid new measurement/control claims

held_source_design_questions.source_bound: SOSA-B inspected selected relevant source clauses; not every table, hardware rule, endpoint or security requirement across chapters
held_source_design_questions.required_non_inference: Do not mark entire 403-page architecture or all 12-source donor lineage fully source-reviewed
